name: stamp
title: Move Stamp Path
description: Moves an existing Stamp to a new semantic location while preserving its stable ID, atomically updating the selected PATHS registry, rescanning the House, and rolling back if verification fails.

settings.name: address
settings.title: Stamp Address
settings.description: Flat PATHS address of the Stamp to move.

settings.name: scope
settings.title: Scope
settings.description: Move the House Stamp or a project-local override.
settings.question: Move the House capability or a project-local override?

settings.name: destination
settings.title: Destination
settings.description: New semantic path relative to tools/ for House scope or project root for project scope. Leaf name must remain unchanged.

settings.name: confirm
settings.title: Confirm
settings.description: Explicit operator confirmation for this control-plane mutation.
settings.question: Confirm this control-plane path move?
